delta_since_slice75.what_a_catch_up_is: Two UTC days closed between packs because the human was late. It is two rows appended to one file. It licenses no second look at the rule, no wider universe, no new intake and no re-read of the clear. The only thing it changes is the FLAG count, because each closed bar promotes the previous last-bar setup and two closed bars promote two. EDGE.md §59b.
delta_since_slice75.why_this_field_exists: t1 does not move, so once one bar lands after it extension_present is permanently true and re-reporting it reads like progress every slice. The informative quantity is the DELTA, and it is written here so a reader does not have to diff two artefacts to learn whether anything happened. EDGE.md §46c.

prior_digest_audit.why_equality_alone_is_not_the_test: Two equal digests can mean the constant named its own value (defect) or that the corpus genuinely did not move (correct). Slice 71's funding constant is the second kind — the file was RECOMPRESSED, not changed, which is the §54d case — and slice 63's linear constant is the same shape, checked by row count because slice 62's artefact carries no digests block at all. Reporting either as a defect would inflate the count; reporting the real ones as legitimate would hide them. Both comparisons are made and the verdict names which one decided it.
prior_digest_audit.how_a_self_compare_hides: It is not caught by a digest check, because both digests are real and both are correctly computed. It is caught only by asking WHOSE digest the constant is, which no field in the artefact asked until this slice. EDGE.md §59d.

digests.the_trap_did_not_fire_this_slice: The funding corpus GENUINELY changed: its UNCOMPRESSED digest moved and 7 new prints arrived, running through 2026-08-25T16:00:00+00:00. The same check answered 'recompressed, not changed' in slice 71 and 'changed' in slices 72 through 75, so the two situations are told apart by the instrument rather than by the reader's expectations. EDGE.md §46c, §54d.
digests.the_trap: The note's digest differs from slice 62's, which read alone says the linear corpus changed. It did not. Both figures are digests of the COMPRESSED file and gzip's header varies between compression runs; the uncompressed streams are byte-identical. TWO DIFFERENT COMPRESSED DIGESTS OVER IDENTICAL CONTENT. Had the check been the one the note quotes, this slice would have opened by reporting a change that did not happen — and a later slice, seeing the same thing in reverse, could have missed one that did.

forward_funding_regime.why_a_setup_is_not_a_trade: A setup is a property of one bar's funding rate. A trade needs an ENTRY, which the rule places at the following bar's open, and an EXIT inside the corpus. A setup on the final bar has neither. Counting it as a trade, an observation, or gate progress would be the slice-59 substitution — activity relabelled as experience. EDGE.md §55b.
forward_funding_regime.join_rule: funding_at_decision reads funding.at_or_before(close_time_ms(bar)) — the rate STANDING AT THE BAR'S CLOSE, reading only backwards in time
forward_funding_regime.newest_decision_is_final: close_time_ms falls back to start_ms + 86_400_000 - 1 and these bars carry no end_us, so the newest decision instant is 23:59:59.999Z — STRICTLY BEFORE the next day's 00:00 funding print. A print stamped exactly at midnight, which this file does not yet carry, could not retroactively revise the newest decision. The join is final the moment the bar closes. EDGE.md §54b.
forward_funding_regime.what_those_two_fields_mean: COVERS = the join returns a rate for the newest decision, i.e. a print exists at or before its close. EXTENDS PAST = the corpus also carries prints later than that instant, which is a freshness signal about the FILE and cannot change the decision, because close_time_ms is 23:59:59.999 and the join reads only backwards. Slice 71 had covers=True, extends_past=False; this slice has both true.

threshold_census.finding: 1182 of 4431 prints (26.7%) sit at EXACTLY 0.0001, and 282 exceed it, with a maximum of 0.00088148. So it is not a cap — it is the venue's BASE funding rate and the modal value of the corpus. FUND_ABS sits on that mode with an inclusive comparison, which means the rule fades BASE-OR-ABOVE funding rather than extreme funding. The selectivity comes from the close-time join and one_entry_per_contiguous_run, not from the threshold being rare. This corrects the programme's LANGUAGE and moves no measured number; the OOS null was scored on the same threshold by the same code, so whatever the threshold admits it admitted for both sides. EDGE.md §57c.

base_rate_runs.finding: The rate has printed exactly 0.0001 for 2 consecutive prints (16 hours). Against this corpus's own history that is unremarkable: 295 such runs, mean 4.01 prints, longest 70. The setups are accumulating because the book is BALANCED, not because anything is extreme — the same fact §57c reported as a census, now visible in the forward window. It is also the moment at which moving FUND_ABS would feel most reasonable and be most wrong. EDGE.md §57c, §58d.

forward_funding_regime.finding: 5 of 15 forward decisions reached FUND_ABS = 0.0001: 2026-08-19, 2026-08-21, 2026-08-22, 2026-08-23, 2026-08-24. The newest, 2026-08-24, close-joins at 0.00010000 — its 16:00 print, which stands at the bar's close (23:59:59.999Z, strictly before the 2026-08-25T00:00Z print) — and the comparison is inclusive, so it is a SHORT setup. It is the LAST BAR, so directed_signal_bars excludes it and it is not a flag. 2026-08-22 AND 2026-08-23 made exactly that transition this slice: 08-22 was a last-bar setup in slice 75, and 08-23 was a setup and a last bar within this same catch-up. Two closed bars promote two, which is arithmetic about which bar is last and not momentum. EDGE.md §59b. WHAT THE THRESHOLD ACTUALLY SELECTS. 0.00010000 is the venue's BASE funding rate, not a cap and not an extreme: it is the single most common value in this corpus at 1,182 of 4,431 prints (26.7%), while 282 prints exceed it and the maximum is 0.00088148. FUND_ABS sits exactly on that mode with an inclusive comparison, so the rule fades BASE-OR-ABOVE funding, and its selectivity comes from the close-time join and the contiguous-run schedule rather than from the threshold being rare. This is a correction to how the rule has been DESCRIBED; no measured number moves, and it is emphatically not a reason to touch FUND_ABS. EDGE.md §57c. NO PARAMETER MOVED: FUND_ABS is 0.0001 and the market printed 0.00010000. EDGE.md §51c, §57b.
forward_funding_regime.why_not: A threshold adjusted after seeing which prints missed it is a threshold fitted to the data, and a narrow miss makes the temptation larger rather than the change more defensible. FUND_ABS stays 0.0001; the horizon stays 5; the join stays close-time — and §57c, which shows the threshold sits on the venue's BASE rate rather than on an extreme, is a correction to the programme's language and not a licence to move it. A threshold re-derived after seeing which prints qualify is fitted to data whether the re-derivation is dressed as an optimisation or as a correction. Three near misses were recorded across slices 70 and 71 and neither available rescue — moving the join, moving the threshold — was taken; each is exactly the change that would void the n=41 clear these bars are measured against. That restraint is what makes this slice's setup worth anything: a threshold reached by a market is evidence, and a threshold reached because it was lowered is not. The distinction only exists because nothing was moved while the misses were accumulating.

why_manifests_not_edited: Rewriting a data-provenance record to state whatever the files say would be asserting a provenance this programme cannot attest: nothing here knows independently that ETH should hold 1461 rows rather than having lost two. A manifest that agrees with disk by construction certifies nothing. The false claims are enumerated by name in tests instead. EDGE.md §47b.
why_no_fetch: The human supplies the data on disk, which is the sanctioned path. Slice 60 recorded a ProxyError against the venue from this environment and nothing has changed; a fetch would add a log line and no evidence.
